marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major US hyperscalers reaffirmed elevated capital expenditure plans for AI infrastructure, driving sustained order momentum for advanced GPU accelerators and high-bandwidth memory suppliers.
marketLayer.inference: Revenue visibility remains robust for hardware ecosystem leaders, supporting valuation multiples across the semiconductor supply chain despite broader macroeconomic caution.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Supply chain bottlenecks in advanced packaging and potential regulatory shifts in international chip export controls.

marketLayer.title: HK China Internet & Platform Economy
marketLayer.fact: Leading Hong Kong-listed tech platforms expanded their share buyback initiatives while showing steady growth in cloud infrastructure and AI-driven ad monetization metrics.
marketLayer.inference: Aggressive capital returns (buybacks and dividends) provide a strong floor for equity valuations, shifting investor focus toward structural efficiency over pure top-line expansion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persistent domestic price competition in core e-commerce and logistics, alongside the pace of macroeconomic recovery in Chinese consumer spending.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Policy & Macro Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: U.S. headline inflation indicators cooled near targeted ranges, cementing market consensus for upcoming interest rate reductions and stabilizing US Treasury yields.
marketLayer.inference: Easing monetary policy pressure enhances global liquidity conditions, reducing equity cost-of-capital and favoring growth stocks in both US and emerging Asian markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Resilience in service-sector core inflation or unexpected employment shocks altering the pace of Fed rate cuts.

marketLayer.title: HK Electric Vehicles & Auto Supply Chain
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed Chinese EV makers reported record delivery volumes driven by new model cycles and expanding export footprints into Southeast Asia and the Middle East.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas expansion offers a secondary growth engine, helping top-tier players maintain margin stability against domestic domestic price pressures.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Increased trade friction, including foreign tariff investigations and localized protectionist trade policies in key export destinations.
